scripts.dev:docker: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "PORT=4000 npm run dev:api" "PORT=3000 npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: concurrently "npm --prefix apps/api run build" "npm --prefix apps/web run build"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
